scope: Only vstupenky.online Wix app icon and its app profile metadata; no component version release or App Market submission.
nativeProcedure: App Profile > App Info > update icon > Upload Media > Link (URL) > import immutable hosted PNG > Add to Page > Save. Cold-reloaded listing response, checked original Wix CDN bytes, then App Distribution > Update App Profile; Wix confirmed App profile updated.
note: CDP file-input upload was unavailable; Wix's native URL import was used.
